sentences.text: Afghanistan -LRB- -LSB- æfˈɡænᵻstæn -RSB- Pashto/Dari : , Afġānistān -RRB- , officially the Islamic Republic of Afghanistan , is a landlocked country located within South Asia and Central Asia .	Pashto	Pashto	Dari	Dari language	landlocked country	landlocked country	South Asia	South Asia	Central Asia	Central Asia
It has a population of 33 million , making it the 42nd most populous country in the world .	42nd	list of countries by population

It is bordered by Pakistan in the south and east ; Iran in the west ; Turkmenistan , Uzbekistan , and Tajikistan in the north ; and China in the far northeast .	Pakistan	Pakistan	Iran	Iran	Turkmenistan	Turkmenistan	Uzbekistan	Uzbekistan	Tajikistan	Tajikistan	China	China
Its territory covers 652,000 km2 , making it the 41st largest country in the world .	41st largest	List of countries and dependencies by area

Human habitation in Afghanistan dates back to the Middle Paleolithic Era , and the country 's strategic location along the Silk Road connected it to the cultures of the Middle East and other parts of Asia .	Middle Paleolithic	Middle Paleolithic	strategic	Geostrategy	Silk Road	Silk Road

Through the ages the land has been home to various peoples and witnessed numerous military campaigns , notably by Alexander the Great , Mauryas , Muslim Arabs , Mongols , British , Soviet , and in the modern era by Western powers . The political history of the modern state of Afghanistan began with the Hotak and Durrani dynasties in the 18th century .
